response.description:
High-scale mesh using connected
group in Azure Virtual Network
Manager is now in general availability. In available regions, customers may connect
up to 3,000 virtual networks in a single mesh connectivity configuration by
default and higher scale IP connectivity within those virtual networks available
by request. Manage
connectivity across large virtual network environments without creating and
maintaining individual peerings. High-scale mesh uses the familiar network
group and connectivity configuration model, helping you keep applications and
business units in separate virtual networks while simplifying direct
network-to-network
connectivity.            Learn
more.
response.title: Generally Available: High-scale mesh in Azure Virtual Network Manager
